rationale: Tests recall of the six recognised sub-disciplines of forensic medicine listed in the core definitions content block
Tests understanding of the BNS/BNSS replacement of IPC/CrPC — a critical legislative update for medicolegal practice
Tests knowledge of the three 2023 statutes that replaced IPC/CrPC/IEA — fundamental to FM1.3 which requires knowing the current legal framework
Tests understanding of court hierarchy — specifically whether the High Court is India's apex court, which is a common misconception
Tests understanding of the witness examination sequence — a core FM1.5 competency on doctor conduct in court
Tests understanding of the legal conditions for a valid dying declaration under the BSA 2023
Tests knowledge of the five foundational principles of medicolegal documentation — core FM1.8 content
Tests the critical point that 'cardiac arrest' is not an acceptable underlying cause of death on the MCCD — FM1.9 competency on death certification
Tests application of dying declaration principles to a clinical scenario — FM14.18 is a performance competency requiring applied knowledge
Tests understanding of the expert witness role — FM14.20 covers conduct in court, and this addresses the distinction between expert and ordinary witnesses
